ValidationRule.description: #15118 : Book to Bill | Implementation Team: Only IM_Sales_IMTN profile to have edit access to B2B related fields
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.HasB2BFieldsEditPermission__c.Has_Edit_Access__c), OR( AND( ISNEW(), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Updated_Billing_Outlook__c )), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Delay_Reasons_B2B_Billing_Outlook__c))) ) ), ISCHANGED(Updated_Billing_Outlook__c), ISCHANGED(Forecast_Revenue_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Delay_Reasons_B2B_Billing_Outlook__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have edit permission on Forecast Billing Date, Updated Billing Outlook and Delay Reason.
